{{Attr|Burn}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Wraith''' was an enemy that appeared in the second, third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It was very similar to the [[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)|Ghost]] that appeared before it in the second and third night, however it had slightly faster speed and higher health. ==Appearance== The '''Wraith''' had a black translucent skin and a violet head. Its arms were cut into three pieces. It wore a black translucent cape and a hood. It also had a lock around its neck. It floated slightly above the ground. ==Strategy== *Cheap towers with high DPS and hidden detection, such as the [[Scout]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Minigunner]] are recommended against this. **Having the {{Color|Golden}} skins for the these towers will improve their performance. *The [[Accelerator]] is effective against the '''Wraith''', provided you can afford one. *The '''Wraiths''' are immune to [[Splash Damage]], so towers like the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] are useless against this. **The [[Swarmer]]'s ''Beehive Grenade'' ability will also not apply the stinging effect on them. *[[Units]], such as from the [[Military Base]], are useless against the '''Wraith'''. *You can use a Level 4 [[Ace Pilot]] to temporarily grant towers hidden detection to attack the '''Wraith'''. **Be aware that it is quite expensive to afford early on, when the '''Wraith''' first appears. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Wraith''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Wraith''' had the most appearances out of any enemy in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], appearing in three nights. ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Wraith''' added. *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **Now appears in the [[Tower Outskirts]]. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Wraith''' removed. {{FoggyForest|[[Ghost (Solar Eclipse)|Ghost]]|Wave 5|Wraith|Wave 7|[[Ent]]|Wave 9}} {{TowerOutskirts|[[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]]|Wave 8|Wraith|Wave 10|[[Zombie Horse]] & [[Ent]]|Wave 11}} {{TotalityTower|[[Clanker]]|Wave 4|Wraith|Wave 6|[[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]] & [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
